firmographics.industry: Retail & Hardware DistributionSector: Hardware & Building MaterialsSODIS-MAD CI, a prominent hardware retailer in Côte d’Ivoire, specializes in supplying building materials and hardware products across multiple locations. Previously operating with SAGE ERP, SODIS sought to enhance its operational efficiency by fully moving into Odoo ERP for its business processes. The company faced challenges in managing accounting, inventory, sales, and intercompany transactions due to fragmented systems and manual workflows. Partnering with Azkatech, an Odoo Gold Partner, SODIS-MAD CI embarked on a digital transformation journey by implementing a tailored Odoo ERP solution. The system covers accounting with Côte d’Ivoire localization, intercompany transactions, cost center tracking, and financial reporting. Additionally, it covers inventory and sales management to optimize warehouse operations, purchase orders, stock valuation, and shipping costs, pricing strategies, and sales reporting, with the integration of POS. This end-to-end ERP transformation empowered the company to enhance decision-making, reduce costs, and scale its business with greater agility in the competitive hardware market.

firmographics.industry: Bakery & Retail (Multiple outlets – Central Africa)Challenge: Aicha Panaderia & Pasteleria, a growing bakery brand with multiple retail outlets, faced operational challenges due to disconnected systems and manual processes. Managing sales, inventory, procurement, and financial reporting across multiple stores made it difficult to maintain stock accuracy, monitor store performance, and ensure consistent business operations.Solution: As a trusted Odoo Partner in UAE, Fidobe Solutions implemented a fully integrated Odoo ERP solution covering Accounting, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, and a multi-store Odoo POS system. The centralized platform enabled real-time sales monitoring, automated inventory management, streamlined procurement, and consolidated financial reporting, providing complete visibility across all retail locations.Results: Following the successful implementation, Aicha Panaderia & Pasteleria gained real-time control over sales, inventory, and financial operations across all outlets. Sales reporting visibility improved by over 42%, while inventory accuracy increased by nearly 40%, significantly reducing stock discrepancies. The integrated Odoo POS system improved billing efficiency, accelerated daily sales reconciliation, and enhanced customer service. Today, the business operates on a scalable ERP platform that supports efficient retail operations and future expansion across the UAE.Implemented by Fidobe Solution:Dubai Address: 611, Office Court Building, Concord Tower, Oud Metha, DubaiPhone/Whatsapp:  (+971) 56 699 1990/(+971) 4 2353931Email: sales@fidobe.com | Website: www.fidobe.com
